audit_scope: Cross-repository architecture, purity/ownership, composition and parallel generation direction; read-only source and retained evidence only.
finding_conclusion: No concrete correctness, purity or shared-mutable-state defect established in the inspected paths. This is not a proof that every formula, adapter, callback or interleaving is correct.
direction: The central architecture is appropriate for independent calculations. Focus next engineering on a measured local end-to-end throughput use case, not another broad infrastructure/platform layer.

confidence.general_shared_state_safety: moderate, caller-owned callbacks/accumulators and trusted factories require ownership discipline

recommendations.summary: Preserve the pure calculation / adapter / worker split; publish one direct caller recipe before expanding infrastructure.
recommendations.detail: Use caller-supplied immutable CanonicalBatch/config/context, compute independent family results, then compose_features; acquire and publish outside the calculation. Keep strategy/label/evidence/agent packages optional consumers. Do not make a scheduler, service, audit ledger or platform-enforcement layer prerequisite to local calculations.

recommendations.summary: Profile representative end-to-end jobs before choosing parallelism or a native kernel.
recommendations.detail: Measure acquisition, canonical conversion, validation, pure compute, process transport, result encoding, publication and readback separately and together. Use independent numerical/status/quality/evidence/identity parity. Current reducers loop in Python and Arrow/NumPy bridges materialize Python values; source inspection establishes possible costs, not dominant cost or a speedup. Existing R8 evidence retained sequential1; it is workload-specific and does not forbid a new justified workload.

recommendations.summary: Reuse existing coarse task/process execution; parallelize independent populations, retain order and dependency barriers.
recommendations.detail: Supervisor already supports sequential/thread/spawn-process modes with bounded in-flight work and resource declarations. Same-instrument connected tasks stay in one shard; this is conservative scheduling, not a correctness defect. Whole-shard completion and coordinator-only publication add latency/buffering. Measure shard skew, startup/pickle/transport and serialized sink cost before changing either partitioning or streaming completion. Never split history/carry/universe dependencies arbitrarily; only use declared legal merges.

recommendations.summary: State sharing is safe only under the current ownership contracts.
recommendations.detail: Canonical batches/results and composition specs are concrete immutable tuples/records; each batch calculation builds local reduction state. SessionAccumulator is mutable caller-owned state and should have one owner per stream. InputReuseCache/Supervisor enforce creating-thread ownership; SerialPublisher owns the sink drain. Caller-supplied callbacks/factories are trusted local code: top-level callback checks do not prove purity, prevent global mutation or make thread execution race-free. Register/freeze factories before concurrent work and give each task/owner its own mutable components.

positive_source_observations: Core feature distribution depends inward only on contracts; numerical optional columnar dependencies isolated in extra. No concrete I/O, wall clock, scheduler or publication import found in inspected numerical entry paths.

CanonicalBatch snapshots concrete columns and validates scalar schema; family calculations build per-call reducer state. Composition preserves complete results and validates config/timing/source identity instead of executing undeclared dependencies.

I/O registry factories receive explicit configurations/credential-provider boundary; DuckDB reader uses local connection/context and configured resource settings. Publication envelope and receipt validation preserve complete typed results and idempotency identity.

Workers acquire/validate supplied batches before pure compute; typed manifests and dependency/universe admission separate readiness from mathematical functions. Supervisor runs pure tasks without sharing source/sink handles and publishes in coordinator.

Incremental legal merge rejects continuous-carry merge and requires matching binding/adjacent nonempty spans; snapshots and explicit order checks prevent treating arbitrary partitions as interchangeable.
checks: Source/static import searches and manual affected-caller inspection; no product imports, numerical tests, benchmarks, builds, installations, provider/native/network workloads or probes.
Inspected exact source-freeze clean worktree files; findings would require exact head/path/line/trigger/consequence. No hypothetical-risk findings or performance claims were fabricated.
limitations: Not an exhaustive review of every package, feature equation, service/MCP/ledger/security or filesystem race; no new SEC/platform enforcement scope.
No new execution or measured speed/capacity result; existing R8 synthetic measurements are historical evidence with their original machine/workload limits.
Static top-level callback admission is not sandboxing or proof of arbitrary trusted caller purity/thread-safety; current library contracts leave this ownership with caller.
Package correctness evidence from accepted releases is not rerun or regenerated by this audit.
Read-only shell/source-inspection helper processes only; no calculation, data-adapter, worker pool or product workload launched.
